criteria.rationale: Examined the B35 exit gate (.pose/roadmaps/pose-shared-runtime.md:77-81) against the code and the measurement: identity handshake plus a per-request identity check before the handler (worktreeruntime/runtime.go:421-456), peer-UID-protected Unix socket (runtime.go:404-408), lifecycle with stop, drain and idle (runtime.go:375-391, 470-487), and standalone fallback with no rerun after an ambiguous reply (runtime_host.go:168-172). The fourth measurement run passes T1-T7, with RAM, CPU and latency per scenario and two heavy checks at once (measurements.json:433-439). The departures (no watcher, because the memo is keyed by commit; no-rerun in place of a receipt; no CPU quota or per-command limits) are recorded in the ADR amendment and at roadmap :74. Concluded that the gate has falsifiable evidence.

The three member contracts compose: the endpoint and handshake of pose-optional-worktree-runtime host the typed read checks and the resident memo of pose-worktree-runtime-resident-cache, which run in the admission lanes of pose-worktree-runtime-qos-and-measurement (runtime_host.go:106-120). Sealed integration evidence passes for all three (optional-worktree-runtime-integration, resident-cache-integration, runtime-qos-integration).

The roadmap names three member specs (:67). Each is status: done (.pose/specs/2026-10-14-pose-optional-worktree-runtime.md:3, 2026-11-09-pose-worktree-runtime-resident-cache.md:3, 2026-11-09-pose-worktree-runtime-qos-and-measurement.md:3), and none of their delivered code changed since their closure and the round-5 approval.

Cumulative module validation is sealed as passing: build:pose-mcp/go/build, unit:pose-mcp/go/test and every pose-mcp integration and reachability check listed in the bundle pass, including the checks covering the out-of-milestone changes in this range (check-index-generation-integration, sealed-checkout-child-evidence-integration). I could not rerun them in this profile.

The cross-spec items not delivered (CPU quota and affinity, per-command limits, Windows named pipe, routing checks to the runtime by default) are recorded in the ADR amendment and the roadmap state (:18-20) as separate draft specs. The remaining carried items, R3-N4 and R3-N5, are low-severity measurement and accounting imprecisions with no effect on correctness or security, and were accepted as low risks in earlier rounds.
